title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 7 · Banquet hall

sourceRecords.title: Area 7 · Banquet hall
read: Once a grand hall, this chamber now smells of stale food and a neglected brazier. Goblin voices rise around two scarred tables.

The two tables take up much of the social space, with the neglected brazier drawing stale smells around it. The voices give you something to listen to before you answer them. You can remain at the edge, make your presence clear, or take stock of the route back out.

brief: Castle banquet hall, TWENTY-FIVE-foot ceiling, west portion collapsed into rubble wall. TWO large wooden tables with plain benches, dirty dishes, half-full stew pots, moldy bread and bones. ONE brass brazier glowing in corner. EIGHT goblins TOTAL, including fat chief cook Yegg bullying seven assistants. No banquet of humans, royal throne or five-star kitchen.
